# `Q-7-6` — Input Excluded From Render List

> The named input is inside a Quarto project but the project's
> render list excludes it.

## What this means

A Quarto project can opt into rendering only a subset of its
files via `project.render` in `_quarto.yml`, and Quarto skips
files that match the conventions for hidden or in-progress
content (filenames starting with `_` or `.`). This error fires
when you pass an explicit path to a file that is otherwise
excluded — Quarto refuses to render it, because the project's
configuration says it shouldn't.

## Why this happens

Common causes:

- **An underscore-prefixed file** (`_draft.qmd`) — these are
  excluded by convention.
- **A file outside an explicit `project.render` list** — when
  `project.render` is set, only listed paths render.
- **A hidden directory** (`.hidden/`) — files inside hidden
  directories are excluded too.

## How to fix

Either:

- **Render without naming the file**, if you want the project's
  exclusion to stand.
- **Rename or move the file** out of the excluded position.
- **Update `project.render`** in `_quarto.yml` to include the
  file.
